text: パソコンを　みると　なんと　でんしメールが　きていた！

structure.jp: パソコンを　みると
structure.en: when I looked at the PC

structure.jp: でんしメールが　きていた！

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb can say 'when I did this, I found that'. パソコンを　みると = 'when I looked at the PC'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: いる after a て-form verb can say something happened and stays that way; いた puts it in the past. きていた = 'had arrived (and was there)'.
